name: gameday/optional_tools
description: One per fresh agent report, labelled by which optional tools it called ('none', 'find_replacements', 'search_news+find_replacements'...). A rate to chart, never an alert: zero is often right.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="gameday-report" AND jsonPayload.event="report" AND jsonPayload.dry_run=false AND jsonPayload.source="agent"
